top_stories.summary: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has pledged ongoing support for Ukraine despite what he described as outrageous threats from Russia. The commitment comes as Ukraine celebrates Independence Day amid the war's latest escalation and renewed Black Sea blockade pressures on Ukrainian farmers.

top_stories.title: Trump's Arctic rhetoric boosts Iceland's pro-EU campaign
top_stories.summary: Saber-rattling by the Trump administration over the Arctic has strengthened the campaign for Iceland to join the European Union. The geopolitical pressure has added momentum to Iceland's EU accession debate.

europe_now.title: Ukraine faces €23B defense funding hole as Western cash lags
europe_now.summary: Ukraine is confronting a €23 billion shortfall in defense financing as promised Western military aid continues to lag behind requirements. The gap underscores growing strain on Kyiv's ability to sustain its war effort against Russian advances.

europe_now.title: EU deficit rules linked to firefighter cuts during severe wildfire season
europe_now.summary: EU fiscal regulations are forcing member states to reduce firefighting personnel even as wildfire activity intensifies across the continent. The cuts have raised concerns about preparedness during an especially severe fire season.

top_stories.title: Saudi Arabia to invest €6B in French theme park project
top_stories.summary: Saudi Arabia has pledged €6 billion to fund a manga-inspired theme park development near Paris. The investment was announced during high-level talks between French and Saudi officials.

top_stories.title: UK and France re-announce anti-missile technology for Ukraine
top_stories.summary: The UK and France have jointly announced new anti-missile defense systems intended for Ukraine, though officials acknowledged none will be operational for several years. The announcement comes amid intensified Russian attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure.

top_stories.title: Spain calls national security meeting over Ceuta migration crisis
top_stories.summary: Spain has convened a national security council meeting to address ongoing migration pressures at the Ceuta enclave. The crisis has persisted for over three weeks, prompting urgent governmental response.

top_stories.title: Poland implements regulation recognising foreign same-sex marriages
top_stories.summary: A new regulation in Poland has come into effect formally recognising same-sex marriages performed abroad. The move marks a significant shift in the country's legal stance on LGBTQ+ rights.
